data.one_liner: Fold-aware Flutter widgets and layouts for iPhone Duo devices.
data.what_it_does: Provides a native bridge to detect device folds, hinges, and size classes on iPhone Duo. Includes fold-aware two-pane layouts, adaptive scaffolds, and aligned grids to handle dual-screen device layouts.
use_when: Building Flutter applications targeting the iPhone Duo
Implementing fold-aware split-pane views or hinge-aligned grids
avoid_when: Building apps that do not target foldable iOS devices
strengths: Fills the gap where MediaQuery display features stay empty on iOS
Supports both custom Flutter-drawn bars and official UIKit Liquid Glass via a companion package
Gracefully falls back on standard devices and platforms
weaknesses: Targeted specifically at a single emerging device form factor
Requires iOS 15+ and the UIScene life cycle
data.setup_notes: Requires wrapping the app root with DuoScope and DuoDisplayFeatures.
